verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs say vector search keeps >90% recall "combined with any filters" and that the index auto-tunes for 90-100% recall, with a recall endpoint for self-testing. Exact kNN over a filtered subset and per-attribute filterable indexing round out the filtering story. Missing for 10: documentation of supported filter operators/conditions, latency figures specifically for filtered queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of filtered recall and latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: Vector search, >90% recall, combined with any filters, dense & sparse
The vector index is automatically tuned for 90-100% recall ("accuracy")... You can use the recall endpoint to test yourself.
kNN (exact search): find the exact nearest neighbors over a filtered subset
marking attributes as `filterable: false` will improve indexing performance and grant you a 50% discount
